caption: The drawing features a single rectangular wooden chest, depicted in a three-quarter view from above. The chest has a lid that spans the entire top, with visible wood grain patterns rendered in shades of brown, beige, and gray. The front side of the chest includes a keyhole, suggesting it is lockable. The sides and front of the chest are shaded to show depth, giving the drawing a sense of dimension. The chest stands on four short legs, one visible at each corner of the front. The background is plain and unadorned, with an overall beige or off-white color, and there are some faint marks or smudges visible on the paper. There are also pencil markings and writing in the bottom right corner outside the depicted object. The color palette consists primarily of muted earth tones, and the composition centers the chest on an otherwise empty background.
title: Utility Chest
